pages.text: While holding a weapon capable of sweeping attacks, perform an attack after charging for at least $(thing)50%$() to trigger $(thing)Cleave$(). For $(thing)0.5 seconds$():$(li)Entity interaction range is doubled$(li)Gains additional damage multiplier equal to your sweeping damage ratio$(li)Enemies swept by the crosshair are automatically struck with full-strength attacks$(li)Only one enemy per direction can be hit by default$(li)Each level of $(thing)Sweeping Edge$() grants one additional penetration$(li)Each enemy can be hit at most once per activation
